name: Item trackers
source: Bluetooth SIG 16-bit UUID member registry + vendor company IDs, verified 2026-10-31. These mirror TrackerParser; the rule engine uses them for UI labelling, while TrackerParser does the authoritative payload decode (state, battery, DULT).

rules.label: Apple Find My
rules.note: Company ID 0x004C (Apple); Find My Network accessory service 0xFD44.

rules.label: Google Find My Device
rules.note: FMDN service data 0xFEAA. NB: collides with legacy Eddystone; TrackerParser disambiguates by FMDN frame byte (0x40/0x41).
